title: Fix Your Bank Account Now
script:
Your bank account hits zero by the fifteenth every single month, and it is not your salary's fault. The problem is not how much you earn, it is that your money has no plan the second it arrives.

Here is the fix. The moment your paycheck lands, split it into three buckets before you spend a single rupee. Fifty percent for your needs, thirty percent for your wants, and twenty percent straight into savings.

Automate that split on payday and you will never have to rely on willpower again. When the money is already moved, you cannot overspend it, and your savings grow without you even thinking about it.

Stop waiting for a raise to fix your money. Fix the system today, and your bank account will finally start working for you. Follow PocketIQ for one fast money fix every single day.
